parameters.name: DESCRIPT
parameters.help: Use MB1 to select/add the dataset file description for the output dataset you wish to create. (Up to 35 chars.)

parameters.name: STATUS
parameters.help: Create a new file, write over an existing file with a new version of the 'same' data, or add new data to the end.

parameters.name: TMAX
parameters.help: The trace length in milliseconds to output. The default of 0.0 means to output all available data samples.

parameters.name: COMPRESS
parameters.help: Select a format for trace samples.  Samples in memory are always represented as floating point number.

parameters.name: ALTSTORE
parameters.help: Do you wish to use secondary disk storage to store the data (rather than filling the primary storage area)?
